meta.title: No telemetry
meta.description: Turns off session-log uploads, the installed-plugin inventory, feedback session uploads, and Desktop product analytics, and removes the x-deepseek-harness-* identity headers and dsh_* request fields from DeepSeek API requests. Conversations collected while the in-app upload toggle was off are never backfilled, and forks never re-upload history. Restart DeepSeek Harness after installing. Removing this bundle restores the shipped behavior, including any pending backlog. Not covered: update checks, DeepSeek account sign-in device details, and what any API server can see (IP address, API key, and the request itself). Tested with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.5; run the repository's verify script after each update.
